#### List:

- Intro: contractility, adrenergic signalling
- Drug table: class, example, mechanism of action

#### Intro:

+-----------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Contractility         | - Those factors contributing to cardiac performance independent of preload, afterload and heart rate                |
|                       | - ∝ ICF \[Ca^2+^\]                                                                                                  |
+-----------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Adrenergic signalling | - Adrenaline/noradrenaline binds β~1~ adrenoceptor, a G~s~ G protein coupled receptor (GPCR)                        |
|                       | - Activation of adenylyl cyclase → ↑cAMP                                                                            |
|                       | - Activation of PKA → phosphorylation of:                                                                           |
|                       |   - Myosin: ↑rate at which cross-bridge cycling can occur                                                           |
|                       |   - Membrane L-Ca^2+^ and sarcoplasmic reticular ryanodine-sensitive Ca^2+^ channel: ↑Ca^2^+ influx upon activation |
|                       |   - Troponin I and phospholamban: ↑rate of relaxation                                                               |
+-----------------------+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
